images.description: A Scout standing confidently in front of a small group of fellow Scouts, gesturing while explaining an idea, with an outdoor pavilion setting
A collage showing different forms of communication: a person speaking at a podium, someone writing a letter, a group video call on a laptop, and a Scout reading a book

A whiteboard covered with colorful sticky notes listing different communication methods organized by category, with a Scout's hand adding a new note
A Scout showing a colorful collage on a poster board to a merit badge counselor seated at a table, both smiling in a well-lit meeting room
A Scout standing at the front of a meeting room delivering a speech to an attentive group of Scouts and leaders, using confident hand gestures
A simple visual diagram showing the three parts of a speech — Opening, Body, and Closing — with brief labels and an arrow flowing from top to bottom

A Scout holding a phone to their ear and looking at a notepad with event details written on it, preparing to make a professional invitation call
A Scout sitting in the audience of a city council meeting, taking notes in a notebook, with council members seated at a raised desk in the background
A Scout sitting at a desk reviewing handwritten notes and writing a report, with a printed meeting agenda visible beside the notebook
